QR Code generator 1.8.0 by Project Nayuki (MIT).

Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/blob/v1.8.0/typescript-javascript/qrcodegen.ts

Compiled locally from the tagged TypeScript source to ES2020 with TypeScript 5.9.3; trailing whitespace is removed, and comments and the complete MIT license are preserved in the JavaScript file. No runtime dependency, external service or network request is used to encode an Authenticator enrollment QR code.
